# zBTC: Bitcoin–Zenon Interoperability Protocol Specification — `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc`)

> Public RFC `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc`, **Zero-Federation Phased Architecture**): explicitly rejects custodial federated multisigs and defines a phased non-custodial Bitcoin–Zenon interoperability roadmap:
> - **Stage 0 (`0–6 mo`, `0 BTC` bridge custody):** Direct-on-L1 Bitcoin SPV Event Oracle + non-custodial PTLC adaptor & Lightning HTLC atomic swaps.
> - **Stage 1A (`12–18+ mo` incl. audit, `~12.8–18.8 BTC` hard BTC):** Right-sized `BitVMX-CPU` (`n = 8`, 100% BIP-431 TRUC v3, `M = 3–5` operators, `N = 7` pre-committed verifiers, deleted-key `{0.50, 0.25, 0.25}` BTC vaults) + **Bitcoin-Anchored Sovereign ZK Validity Rollup** (`0-of-N` Zenon trust — survives **49%–100%** Zenon compromise, feeless `AccountBlock.Data` sequencer rails, uncensorable Bitcoin L1 forced inbox `0x00..0x07`, immutable `vk_STF`, `0%` ZNN slashing/custody).
> - **Stage 1B Alternative Gate (`3–6 mo`, `2–5 BTC` liquidity):** `clArk` discrete expiring VTXO coordination (relinquishing pooled fungible `zBTC` in favor of `0-of-N` post-round unilateral exit with `log2(N)` L1 exit branches).
> - **Stage 2:** Zero-TTP scaling via `N`-of-`N` voluntary cohort handover or clean non-commingled `zBTC_v2`, plus optional covenant-enabled sovereign ZK-rollup track.
>
> Supersedes archived `v0` (`v2.5.0-rfc`, preserved byte-for-byte under `versions/v0/`).

- **Current Version:** `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc`) — pre-implementation zero-federation RFC open for independent security review. NOT mainnet-active.
- **Archived Version:** `v0` (`v2.5.0-rfc`, commit `7b47b8c`, superseded — do not implement): https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/v0/
- **Changelog & Diffs (`v0 → v1`):** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/changelog/
- **Canonical Web Site:** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec
- **Single-Fetch Full Bundle (`v1`):** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/llms-full.txt
- **Consistency & Bounds Checker:** `python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`

## Normative Specification Files (`v1` / `v3.0.0-rfc`)

Read in authority-precedence order (`SPEC.md §2.1`):

- [Part 1 — Zero-Federation Bitcoin Taproot Vault Enforcement (`BTC-BITVMX-V1`), Stage 1B `clArk` Gate & Track B Annex](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/01-bitcoin-taproot-vault-enforcement.md): Highest precedence. Explicit rejection of federated multisigs; Stage 0 zero-custody baseline; Stage 1A deleted-key `{0.50, 0.25, 0.25}` BTC vaults, `n = 8` `BitVMX-CPU` (`RV32IM`) bisection (`301` W-OTS digits ≈ `7.44 kvB <= 10,000 vB` 100% TRUC v3, `20` steps, `~75 kvB` Prover / `~15 kvB` Verifier, `F_chal = 0.40 BTC`), simultaneous `[0, 144]` challenge window, `T_take = 1,152` / `T_cooldown = 1,296` / `RetireStakeTx = 1,440`, 256-bit Lamport `TakeTx`, dual-input `Stake_r + VaultConnector_r` slashing (`0` BTC stolen, `0.15` L1 / `1.85` burn / `0.55` `B_zbtc` split giving `>= +0.0167 BTC` honest verifier EV), atomic `(2M+1)`-leaf `ExitSlotUTXO`, exact `12.8–18.8 BTC` capital & `~65–72d` 100% bank-run math; Stage 1B `clArk` gate; Stage 2 zero-TTP upgrade boundary & Track B soft-fork annex. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-01/
- [Master Overview (`SPEC.md`)](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/SPEC.md): Zero-federation phased architecture, Theorem 1 & Theorem 2 impossibility/capital bounds, end-to-end flows (Bob `0.5 BTC` under 49% Zenon attack & Mike `0.25 BTC` zero-signer exit), honest threat model, Stage 0/1A/1B/2 gates, `bigidea` claims alignment table, and written Q&A answering Consolidated Hostile Review `R7`. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/
- [Part 2 — Stage 0 Bitcoin SPV Event Oracle & Stage 1A L1 DA / Forced-Inclusion Inbox](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/02-btc-authorization-domain-and-spv.md): Pure-Go panic-recovered (`B1`) Stage 0 SPV Event Oracle with 1- vs 2-block SHA-256 coinbase midstate proof (`len % 64 >= 56` fixed) and `B2` pinned `2.1M` Plasma floor; Stage 1A canonical Bitcoin L1 ordering, complete mutated-leaf DA (`0x02`), uncensorable L1 forced inbox (`0x00..0x07`), and halving-indexed TVL-scaled `K` (`0.50 * K * Subsidy(era) > Cap_TVL`). HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-02/
- [Part 3 — Non-Custodial PTLC/LN Rails, Sovereign Rollup STF & Feeless Zenon Sequencer](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/03-settlement-minted-zbtc-and-feeless-rails.md): Stage 0 hardened PTLC (`>= 72`-blk CSV, confirmed `<= h_conf+66`, `T_znn = 108,000s` = `30h` vs `2.3×` slow blocks) and LN HTLC (`hashType = 1`, `Δ_safety = 36` blks); Stage 1A immutable Rollup SMT (`Accounts`, `Vaults`, `PendingExits`, `OperatorState`, `B_zbtc = 0.60 BTC`/lane), feeless `AccountBlock.Data` sequencer (`~28,480` Plasma, `~14` refundable QSR, `0` sat BTC fee; `~8.8 tx/s` default / `~4.4 tx/s` floor / `~1,050–1,200 tx/s` real `8 MiB` ceiling), and Stage 1B `clArk` VTXO rails. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-03/
- [Part 4 — Zenon 49% Consensus Boundary, Inverted Trust Hierarchy & Light Clients](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/04-bitcoin-anchoring-and-light-client.md): Code-grounded proof of why `go-zenon` DPoS fails at 49% (height-only grindable `findSeed`, unweighted top-30 `groupA`, zero slashing, 30-Momentum rollback cliff) and classical BFT fails at `> 33.3%`, proving why Stage 1A inverts trust to Bitcoin L1 (`0-of-N` Zenon trust); optional non-custodial light-client infrastructure. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-04/
- [Part 5 — Detailed `go-zenon` Upgrade Plan & Zero-Hard-Fork Custody Boundary](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/spec/05-go-zenon-upgrade-plan.md): Stage 0 `go-zenon` prerequisites (`0aa299e`, `#239` FIFO receive stall gate, `DynamicPlasmaSpork` + full `SetPlasmaVariables` pinning of `MaxBasePlasmaInMomentum >= 2.1M`, `MaxPriceChangePercent <= 25`, `FusedPlasmaTarget`, `PowPlasmaTarget`, `PriceChangeDenominator`, `PtlcSpork`, SPV Event Oracle) plus Stage 1A/1B zero-hard-fork custody isolation (`vk_STF` immutable on Bitcoin L1; `SporkAddress` cannot steal 1 satoshi). HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/part-05/
- [Changelog (`v0 → v1`)](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/raw/CHANGELOG.md): Complete finding-by-finding disposition of `R7` (`C-1..C-4`, `H-1..H-8`, `M-1..M-15`, `L-1..L-4`) explaining why `v0`'s BitVM2+PoS hybrid failed and why federated multisigs were rejected in favor of Stage 0 → Stage 1A `BitVMX` / Stage 1B `clArk`. HTML: https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/changelog/
